name: materials
description: Materials: condition-aware material properties with measured vs computed provenance. Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT and OQMD (computed, with functional and database release), NIST Chemistry WebBook (measured and evaluated thermochemistry) and the Crystallography Open Database (experimental structures) within a bounded Ti-O/Al-O selection; reviewable phase-level identity; comparison only of comparable values; cited papers and test-method standards; release tracking. Values are never merged, averaged or predicted.

query_examples.intent: What is known about the properties of rutile TiO2, and where does each value come from
query_examples.semantics: every value with native and normalised unit, conditions (unstated stays unstated), method class and functional or technique, uncertainty as published, dataset release, locator and value- vs dataset-level citations resolved by DOI or standard designation only

query_examples.intent: Compare the band gap of one phase across sources
query_examples.semantics: aligned only with the same property, method class, reviewed phase identity and conditions within stated tolerances; different functionals are labelled; everything else side by side as not comparable with reasons; no average or consensus

query_examples.intent: Which acquired materials have a computed band gap between 1.7 and 1.9 eV
query_examples.semantics: bounded to acquired records; current value per source first, then filters; each hit cites its values; absence is not evidence

query_examples.intent: What changed between two Materials Project releases
query_examples.semantics: added, changed (both values cited), deprecated or withdrawn only as the source states, absent otherwise

exclusions: closed commercial databases and handbooks (MatWeb, Granta, Springer Materials, ASM handbooks)
material selection recommendations, suitability-for-use or design-allowable claims
property prediction or ML-estimated values produced by Noesis
unrestricted mirroring of source databases; structure files beyond bounded, licensed fetches
